sourceRefs.locator: Circumstances leading to the find and Discovery site: axe recovered with the body at Tisenjoch, 3,210 m, in 1991
Iceman Discovery Site, opening paragraph: N 46°46′44.004″, E 10°50′21.192″

summary.de: In einer Mulde am Tisenjoch auf der heutigen italienischen Seite der Grenze wurden 1991 Ötzi und seine Ausrüstung geborgen.
summary.en: Ötzi and his equipment were recovered in 1991 from a hollow near Tisenjoch on the present-day Italian side of the border.
